en: Hello, how are you?
Hello sir, are you doing well?
Yes / No, I do not want it.

kn: ಹೌದು ಅಣ್ಣಾ, ಸರಿ. ಇಲ್ಲ, ಇನ್ನೊಂದು ಬೇಡ.
translit: Haudhu anna, sari. Illa, innondhu beda.
en: Yes brother, alright. No, I do not want another one.
Excuse me, please listen for a moment.

kn: ಅಣ್ಣಾ, ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಕೇಳಿ, ಈ ಅಡ್ರೆಸ್ ಎಲ್ಲಿದೆ?
translit: Anna, dhayavittu swalpa keli, ee address ellidhe?
en: Brother, please listen for a moment, where is this address?
Thank you very much.
Thank you very much for showing the way, brother.
Sorry, I did not realize.
Sorry madam, I did not realize.
I did not understand.

kn: ನನಗೆ ಕನ್ನಡ ಅಷ್ಟಾಗಿ ಬರಲ್ಲ, ನೀವು ಹೇಳಿದ್ದು ಅರ್ಥ ಆಗ್ಲಿಲ್ಲ.
translit: Nanage Kannada ashtaagi baralla, neevu heliddhu artha aaglilla.
en: I do not know much Kannada, I did not understand what you said.
Please speak a little slowly.

kn: ನಾನು ಕನ್ನಡ ಕಲಿತಾ ಇದ್ದೀನಿ, ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ನಿಧಾನವಾಗಿ ಹೇಳಿ.
translit: Naanu Kannada kalithaa iddhini, swalpa nidhaanavaagi heli.
en: I am learning Kannada, please speak a little slowly.
Do you speak English?
Sir, do you speak a little English?
Where is the bus stop?

kn: ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಹತ್ರ ಬಸ್ ಸ್ಟಾಪ್ ಎಲ್ಲಿ ಇದೆ?
translit: Illi hathra bus stop elli idhe?
en: Where is the nearest bus stop here?
How much is this?
Sister, how much is this fruit?
One, two, three, four, five.

kn: ಎರಡು ಟೀ ಮತ್ತು ಮೂರು ಇಡ್ಲಿ ಕೊಡಿ.
translit: Eradu tea mathu mooru idli kodi.
en: Give two teas and three idlis.
Six, seven, eight, nine, ten.
I will be there in ten minutes.
Twenty, fifty, one hundred.
Do you have change for a hundred rupees?
Can I get some drinking water?

kn: ತುಂಬಾ ಬಾಯಾರಿಕೆ ಆಗ್ತಿದೆ, ಕುಡಿಯೋಕೆ ನೀರು ಸಿಗುತ್ತಾ?
translit: Thumba baayaarike aagthidhe, kudiyoke neeru siguthaa?
en: I am very thirsty, can I get some drinking water?
Go straight, then take a left.

kn: ಈ ರಸ್ತೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸೀದಾ ಹೋಗಿ, ಸಿಗ್ನಲ್ ಹತ್ರ ಲೆಫ್ಟ್ ತಗೊಳ್ಳಿ.
translit: Ee rastheyalli seedha hogi, signal hathra left thagoli.
en: Go straight on this road and take a left near the signal.
Is it near from here or far?

kn: ರೈಲ್ವೆ ಸ್ಟೇಷನ್ ಇಲ್ಲಿಂದ ಹತ್ರನಾ ಅಥವಾ ದೂರನಾ?
translit: Railway station illindha hathranaa athava dooranaa?
en: Is the railway station near from here or far?
What is this called in Kannada?
Sister, what do they call this vegetable in Kannada?

kn: ನಾನು ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಕನ್ನಡ ಕಲಿತಾ ಇದ್ದೀನಿ.
translit: Naanu swalpa swalpa Kannada kalithaa iddhini.
en: I am learning Kannada little by little.

kn: ನಾನು ಬೆಂಗಳೂರಿಗೆ ಹೊಸಬ, ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಕನ್ನಡ ಕಲಿತಾ ಇದ್ದೀನಿ.
translit: Naanu Bengalurige hosaba, swalpa swalpa Kannada kalithaa iddhini.
en: I am new to Bengaluru, I am learning Kannada little by little.
Okay, alright / done.
Okay brother, alright, I will come tomorrow.
Please help me a bit.

kn: ನನ್ನ ಬ್ಯಾಗ್ ಕಳೆದುಹೋಗಿದೆ, ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡಿ.
translit: Nanna bag kaledhuhogidhe, dhayavittu swalpa sahaaya maadi.
en: My bag is lost, please help me a bit.
Will you go to Majestic?
Brother, will you go to Majestic?
Please turn on the meter.
Please put the meter and drive, brother.
How much will it cost?
How much will it be to Indiranagar?
Stop here.
Stop here ahead on the left.
Take left / Take right.
Take right near the next signal.
Which is the next stop?
Conductor sir, which is the next stop?
Give one ticket.
Give one ticket to Silk Board.
Do you have online payment / UPI?

kn: ಕ್ಯಾಶ್ ಇಲ್ಲ, ಫೋನ್ ಪೇ ಸ್ಕ್ಯಾನರ್ ಇದ್ಯಾ?
en: I have no cash, do you have PhonePe scanner?
Can you please go a little faster?

kn: ಟ್ರೈನ್ ಮಿಸ್ ಆಗುತ್ತೆ, ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಬೇಗ ಹೋಗ್ಬಹುದಾ?
translit: Train miss aaguththe, swalpa bega hogbahudha?
en: I might miss the train, can you go a little faster?
Please make way to get down.

kn: ಸ್ಟಾಪ್ ಬಂತು, ಇಳಿಯೋಕೆ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಜಾಗ ಕೊಡಿ.
translit: Stop banthu, iliyoke swalpa jaaga kodi.
en: The stop has arrived, please give some way to get off.
Which platform does the metro arrive at?
Which platform does the Whitefield metro arrive at?
Where is the metro station?

kn: ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಹತ್ರ ಮೆಟ್ರೋ ಸ್ಟೇಷನ್ ಎಲ್ಲಿ ಇದೆ ಅಣ್ಣಾ?
translit: Illi hathra metro station elli idhe anna?
en: Brother, where is the nearest metro station here?
Does this bus go to Majestic?

kn: ಕಂಡಕ್ಟರ್ ಸರ್, ಈ ಬಸ್ ಮೆಜೆಸ್ಟಿಕ್‌ಗೆ ಹೋಗುತ್ತಾ?
translit: Conductor sir, ee bus Majestic-ge hoguthaa?
en: Conductor sir, does this bus go to Majestic?
Please tell me when the stop comes.

kn: ನನಗೆ ಜಾಗ ಹೊಸದು, ಜಯನಗರ ಸ್ಟಾಪ್ ಬಂದಾಗ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಹೇಳಿ.
translit: Nanage jaaga hosadhu, Jayanagar stop bandhaaga swalpa heli.
en: I am new to this area, please tell me when Jayanagar stop comes.
Where does the bus to Mysuru stand?

kn: ಮೈಸೂರಿಗೆ ಹೋಗೋ ಕೆಎಸ್‌ಆರ್‌ಟಿಸಿ ಬಸ್ ಎಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಲ್ಲುತ್ತೆ?
translit: Mysore-ige hogo KSRTC bus elli nilluththe?
en: Where does the KSRTC bus going to Mysuru stand?
I have sent the location pin.

kn: ಆ್ಯಪ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಲೊಕೇಶನ್ ಪಿನ್ ಕಳಿಸಿದ್ದೀನಿ, ಅಲ್ಲಿಗೆ ಬನ್ನಿ.
translit: App-nalli location pin kalisiddhini, allige banni.
en: I have sent the location pin in the app, please come there.
Come near Gate Number 2.

kn: ನಾನು ಗೇಟ್ ನಂಬರ್ ಎರಡರ ಹತ್ರ ನಿಂತಿದ್ದೀನಿ, ಅಲ್ಲಿಗೆ ಬನ್ನಿ.
translit: Naanu gate number eradara hathra ninthiddhini, allige banni.
en: I am standing near Gate Number 2, please come there.

kn: ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಡಿಕ್ಕಿ ಓಪನ್ ಮಾಡಿ, ಲಗೇಜ್ ಇದೆ.
translit: Swalpa dikki open maadi, luggage idhe.
en: Please open the boot, I have luggage.

kn: ಎರಡು ದೊಡ್ಡ ಬ್ಯಾಗ್ ಇದೆ, ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಡಿಕ್ಕಿ ಓಪನ್ ಮಾಡಿ.
translit: Eradu dodda bag idhe, swalpa dikki open maadi.
en: I have two big bags, please open the boot.
Take a U-turn and stop right there.

kn: ಮುಂದೆ ಯು-ಟರ್ನ್ ತಗೊಂಡು ಪಾರ್ಕ್ ಹತ್ರ ನಿಲ್ಲಿಸಿ.
translit: Munde U-turn thagondu park hathra nillisi.
en: Take a U-turn ahead and stop near the park.
Is the toll charge included in this?

kn: ಏರ್‌ಪೋರ್ಟ್ ಟೋಲ್ ಚಾರ್ಜ್ ಆ್ಯಪ್ ಬಿಲ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಸೇರಿದ್ಯಾ?
translit: Airport toll charge app bill-nalli seridhya?
en: Is the airport toll charge included in the app bill?
How much is this?
Brother, how much is this shirt?
Reduce the price a bit.

kn: ಬೆಲೆ ತುಂಬಾ ಜಾಸ್ತಿ ಆಯ್ತು, ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಕಮ್ಮಿ ಮಾಡಿ.
translit: Bele thumba jaasthi aaythu, swalpa kammi maadi.
en: The price is too high, reduce it a bit.
Do you have another color or size?

kn: ಇದರಲ್ಲಿ ಬ್ಲೂ ಕಲರ್ ಮೀಡಿಯಂ ಸೈಜ್ ಇದ್ಯಾ?
translit: Idharalli blue color medium size idhya?
en: Do you have blue color in medium size for this?
Is this fresh?
Are these vegetables from today, are they fresh?
Give one kilogram.
feedback_or_explanation: Pattern: ಒಂದು ಕಿಲೋ {item} ಕೊಡಿ. (Ondhu kilo {item} kodi.)

en: Give one kilo of good onions.
Give a carry bag.

kn: ಸಾಮಾನು ತಗೊಂಡು ಹೋಗೋಕೆ ಒಂದು ಕವರ್ ಕೊಡಿ.
translit: Saamaanu thagond hogoke ondhu cover kodi.
en: Please give a bag to carry the items.
Do you accept card or UPI scanner?
I'm out of cash, do you take cards?
Give the bill.
Please pack everything and give the bill.
Not this one, show another.

kn: ಇದರ ಕ್ವಾಲಿಟಿ ಸರಿ ಇಲ್ಲ, ಬೇರೆ ತೋರ್ಸಿ.
translit: Idhara quality sari illa, bere thorsi.
en: Quality of this isn't good, show another one.
Please give the change.
I gave 500 rupees, please give the balance change.
Half a kilogram is enough.

kn: ಒಂದು ಕಿಲೋ ಬೇಡ ಅಕ್ಕಾ, ಅರ್ಧ ಕಿಲೋ ಸಾಕು.
translit: Ondhu kilo beda akka, ardha kilo saaku.
en: No need for one kilo sister, half a kilo is enough.
Give a quarter kilogram (250 grams).
Please give a quarter kilo of green chillies.
When is the expiry date of this?

kn: ಈ ಹಾಲಿನ ಪ್ಯಾಕೆಟ್ ಎಕ್ಸ್‌ಪೈರಿ ಡೇಟ್ ಯಾವಾಗ ಇದೆ?
translit: Ee haalina packet expiry date yaavaaga idhe?
en: When is the expiry date on this milk packet?
Can I try this on?

kn: ಈ ಕುರ್ತಾ ಸೈಜ್ ಸರಿ ಇದ್ಯಾ ಅಂತ ಟ್ರೈ ಮಾಡ್ಬಹುದಾ?
translit: Ee kurta size sari idhya antha try maadbahudha?
en: Can I try on this kurta to see if the size fits?
Where is the trial room?

kn: ಸರ್, ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಟ್ರಯಲ್ ರೂಮ್ ಎಲ್ಲಿ ಇದೆ?
translit: Sir, illi trial room elli idhe?
en: Sir, where is the trial room here?
Will you exchange it if the size does not fit?

kn: ಮನೆಗೆ ತಗೊಂಡು ಹೋದ್ಮೇಲೆ ಸೈಜ್ ಸರಿಯಿಲ್ಲ ಅಂದ್ರೆ ಎಕ್ಸ್‌ಚೇಂಜ್ ಮಾಡ್ತೀರಾ?
translit: Manege thagondu hodhmele size sariyilla andre exchange maadthira?
en: If the size does not fit after taking it home, will you exchange it?
What time does the shop open?

kn: ಬೆಳಗ್ಗೆ ಅಂಗಡಿ ಎಷ್ಟು ಗಂಟೆಗೆ ಓಪನ್ ಆಗುತ್ತೆ ಅಣ್ಣಾ?
translit: Belagge angadi eshtu gantege open aaguththe anna?
en: Brother, what time does the shop open in the morning?
Do you deliver to home?

kn: ಅಕ್ಕಿ ಮೂಟೆ ದೊಡ್ಡದಿದೆ, ಮನೆಗೆ ಡೆಲಿವರಿ ಮಾಡ್ತೀರಾ?
translit: Akki moote doddadhidhe, manege delivery maadthira?
en: The rice bag is heavy, do you deliver to home?
Put a little coriander leaves.

kn: ತರಕಾರಿ ತಗೊಂಡಿದ್ದೀನಿ, ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಕೊತ್ತಂಬರಿ ಸೊಪ್ಪು ಕರಿಬೇವು ಹಾಕಿ.
translit: Tharakaari thagondiddhini, swalpa kothambari soppu karibevu haaki.
en: I bought vegetables, please add some coriander and curry leaves.
I have no small change, shall I pay by UPI?

kn: ಇಪ್ಪತ್ತು ರೂಪಾಯಿ ಚಿಲ್ಲರೆ ಇಲ್ಲ ಅಣ್ಣಾ, ಯುಪಿಐ ಮಾಡ್ಲಾ?
translit: Ippathu roopaayi chillare illa anna, UPI maadlaa?
en: I do not have twenty rupees change brother, shall I do UPI?
I have a headache.
I have severe headache since morning.
I have had a fever for two days.

kn: ಚಳಿ ಜೊತೆ ಎರಡು ದಿನದಿಂದ ಜ್ವರ ಬಂದಿದೆ.
translit: Chali jothe eradu dhinadhinda jvara bandhidhe.
en: I have a fever with chills for two days.
I have a stomach ache.

kn: ಊಟ ಮಾಡಿದ ಮೇಲೆ ಹೊಟ್ಟೆ ನೋವು ಬರ್ತಾ ಇದೆ.
translit: Oota maadidha mele hotte novu barthaa idhe.
en: Stomach is aching after having food.
When will the doctor come?
I had an appointment, when will the doctor arrive?
When should I take this tablet?

kn: ದಿನಕ್ಕೆ ಎಷ್ಟು ಸಾರಿ ಈ ಮಾತ್ರೆ ತಗೋಬೇಕು?
translit: Dhinakke eshtu saari ee maathre thagobeku?
en: How many times a day should I take this tablet?
Should I take it after food?

kn: ಖಾಲಿ ಹೊಟ್ಟೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ತಗೋಬೇಕಾ ಅಥವಾ ಊಟ ಆದ್ಮೇಲೆ ತಗೋಬೇಕಾ?
translit: Khaali hotteyalli thagobekaa athava oota aadhmele thagobekaa?
en: Should I take it empty stomach or after food?
I have a cough and throat pain.
Coughing a lot during the night.
I am allergic to this medicine.
I get an allergic reaction if I take penicillin.
Please check blood pressure and blood sugar.

kn: ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ತಲೆ ಸುತ್ತು ಬರ್ತಿದೆ, ಬಿಪಿ ಚೆಕ್ ಮಾಡಿ.
translit: Swalpa thale suthu barthidhe, BP check maadi.
en: Feeling dizzy, please check my blood pressure.
When will the test report be ready?

kn: ಬ್ಲಡ್ ಟೆಸ್ಟ್ ರಿಪೋರ್ಟ್ ಇವತ್ತು ಸಂಜೆ ಸಿಗುತ್ತಾ?
translit: Blood test report ivathu saanje siguthaa?
en: Will the blood test report be ready this evening?
Where is the pharmacy / medical shop?

kn: ಈ ಮಾತ್ರೆ ತಗೊಳ್ಳೋಕೆ ಹತ್ರ ಮೆಡಿಕಲ್ ಶಾಪ್ ಎಲ್ಲಿ ಇದೆ?
translit: Ee maathre thagolloke hathra medical shop elli idhe?
en: Where is the nearest pharmacy to buy these tablets?
Please put a bandage on the wound.

kn: ಕೈಗೆ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಗಾಯ ಆಗಿದೆ, ಕ್ಲೀನ್ ಮಾಡಿ ಬ್ಯಾಂಡೇಜ್ ಹಾಕಿ.
translit: Kaige swalpa gaaya aagidhe, clean maadi bandage haaki.
en: My hand has a small wound, please clean it and put a bandage.
I have body aches all over.

kn: ನೆನ್ನೆಯಿಂದ ಸುಸ್ತಾಗ್ತಿದೆ, ಮೈ ಕೈ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ನೋವು ಇದೆ.
translit: Nenneyindha susthaagthidhe, mai kai ella novu idhe.
en: Since yesterday I feel exhausted and have body aches all over.
I am not able to sleep at night.

kn: ಕೆಮ್ಮಿನಿಂದ ರಾತ್ರಿ ಸರಿಯಾಗಿ ನಿದ್ದೆ ಬರ್ತಿಲ್ಲ ಡಾಕ್ಟರ್.
translit: Kemminindha raathri sariyaagi niddhe barthilla doctor.
en: Because of the cough, I am not able to sleep properly at night, doctor.
Does this tablet cause drowsiness?

kn: ನಾನು ಆಫೀಸ್‌ಗೆ ಹೋಗ್ಬೇಕು, ಈ ಮಾತ್ರೆಯಿಂದ ನಿದ್ದೆ ಬರುತ್ತಾ?
translit: Naanu office-ge hogbeku, ee maathreyindha niddhe baruthaa?
en: I have to go to the office, does this tablet cause drowsiness?
Should I take one each in the morning and at night?

kn: ಈ ಕ್ಯಾಪ್ಸೂಲ್ ಬೆಳಗ್ಗೆ ಮತ್ತು ರಾತ್ರಿ ಒಂದೊಂದು ತಗೋಬೇಕಾ?
translit: Ee capsule belagge mathu raathri ondhondhu thagobekaa?
en: Should I take this capsule one in the morning and one at night?
Should I drink only warm water?

kn: ಗಂಟಲು ನೋವಿಗೆ ಬಿಸಿ ನೀರು ಮಾತ್ರ ಕುಡಿಬೇಕಾ ಡಾಕ್ಟರ್?
translit: Gantalu novige bisi neeru maathra kudibekaa doctor?
en: For throat pain, should I drink only warm water, doctor?
Which floor is the X-ray room on?

kn: ಸಿಸ್ಟರ್, ಎಕ್ಸ್-ರೇ ರೂಮ್ ಯಾವ ಫ್ಲೋರ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಇದೆ?
translit: Sister, X-ray room yaava floor-nalli idhe?
en: Nurse, which floor is the X-ray room on?
Is the health insurance card accepted here?

kn: ರಿಸೆಪ್ಷನ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಕೇಳಿ, ನಮ್ಮ ಆಫೀಸ್ ಇನ್ಶೂರೆನ್ಸ್ ಕಾರ್ಡ್ ನಡೆಯುತ್ತಾ?
translit: Reception-nalli keli, namma office insurance card nadeyuthaa?
en: Ask at the reception if our office insurance card is accepted.
When should I come back for a checkup?

kn: ಮೂರು ದಿನ ಮಾತ್ರೆ ತಗೊಂಡ ಮೇಲೆ ಮತ್ತೆ ಯಾವಾಗ ಚೆಕಪ್‌ಗೆ ಬರಬೇಕು?
translit: Mooru dhina maathre thagonda mele mathe yaavaaga checkup-ge barabeku?
en: After taking the tablets for three days, when should I come back for a checkup?
Please send this file.

kn: ನನ್ನ ಈಮೇಲ್‌ಗೆ ಆ ಪ್ರಾಜೆಕ್ಟ್ ಫೈಲ್ ಕಳಿಸಿ.
translit: Nanna email-ge aa project file kalisi.
en: Please send that project file to my email.
When is the meeting?
When does the client meeting start?
I needed a little help.

kn: ಈ ಟಾಸ್ಕ್ ಮುಗಿಸೋಕೆ ನನಗೆ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಹೆಲ್ಪ್ ಬೇಕಿತ್ತು.
translit: Ee task mugisoke nanage swalpa help bekithu.
en: I needed a little help to finish this task.
I need leave tomorrow.

kn: ಮನೆ ಕೆಲಸ ಇದೆ, ನಾಳೆ ರಜೆ ಬೇಕಾಗಿತ್ತು.
translit: Mane kelasa idhe, naale raje bekaagithu.
en: I have personal work at home, I need leave tomorrow.
This work is completed.
The report work you asked for is completed.
Shall we go for tea / coffee?

kn: ಐದು ನಿಮಿಷ ಬ್ರೇಕ್ ತಗೊಂಡು ಕಾಫಿ ಕುಡಿಯೋಣ್ವಾ?
translit: Aidhu nimisha break thagondu coffee kudiyonwaa?
en: Shall we take a five minute break and have coffee?
Please wait a moment.

kn: ನಾನು ಕಾಲ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಇದ್ದೀನಿ, ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ವೇಟ್ ಮಾಡಿ.
translit: Naanu call-nalli iddhini, swalpa wait maadi.
en: I am on a call, please wait a moment.
The call is not connecting.

kn: ನೆಟ್‌ವರ್ಕ್ ಪ್ರಾಬ್ಲಮ್ ಇದೆ, ಕಾಲ್ ಕನೆಕ್ಟ್ ಆಗ್ತಿಲ್ಲ.
translit: Network problem idhe, call connect aagthilla.
en: There is a network issue, the call is not connecting.
I will check the email and reply.

kn: ಈಗಲೇ ಮೇಲ್ ಚೆಕ್ ಮಾಡಿ ಅಪ್‌ಡೇಟ್ ಕೊಡ್ತೀನಿ.
translit: Eegale mail check maadi update kodthini.
en: I will check the mail right away and give an update.
Thank you very much.
Thank you very much for your help.
I am working from home today.

kn: ಮಳೆ ಜೋರಾಗಿದೆ, ಇವತ್ತು ವರ್ಕ್ ಫ್ರಮ್ ಹೋಮ್ ಮಾಡ್ತಿದ್ದೀನಿ.
translit: Male joraagidhe, ivathu work from home maadthiddhini.
en: It is raining heavily, I am working from home today.

kn: ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಟ್ರಾಫಿಕ್ ಇದೆ, ಹತ್ತು ನಿಮಿಷ ಲೇಟ್ ಆಗುತ್ತೆ.
translit: Swalpa traffic idhe, hathu nimisha late aaguththe.
en: There is some traffic, I will be ten minutes late.

kn: ಸಿಲ್ಕ್ ಬೋರ್ಡ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಟ್ರಾಫಿಕ್ ಇದೆ, ಹತ್ತು ನಿಮಿಷ ಲೇಟ್ ಆಗುತ್ತೆ.
translit: Silk Board-nalli traffic idhe, hathu nimisha late aaguththe.
en: There is traffic at Silk Board, I will be ten minutes late.

kn: ನಿಮ್ಮ ವಾಯ್ಸ್ ಕೇಳಿಸ್ತಿಲ್ಲ, ಮ್ಯೂಟ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಇದ್ಯಾ ನೋಡಿ.
translit: Nimma voice kelisthilla, mute-nalli idhya nodi.
en: Your voice is not audible, check if you are on mute.

kn: ಸರ್, ನಿಮ್ಮ ವಾಯ್ಸ್ ಕೇಳಿಸ್ತಿಲ್ಲ, ಮೈಕ್ ಮ್ಯೂಟ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಇದ್ಯಾ ನೋಡಿ.
translit: Sir, nimma voice kelisthilla, mic mute-nalli idhya nodi.
en: Sir, your voice is not audible, please check if your mic is on mute.
Is my screen visible?

kn: ಸ್ಕ್ರೀನ್ ಶೇರ್ ಮಾಡಿದ್ದೀನಿ, ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ನನ್ನ ಸ್ಕ್ರೀನ್ ಕಾಣಿಸ್ತಿದ್ಯಾ?
translit: Screen share maadiddhini, ellarigu nanna screen kaanisthidhya?
en: I have shared my screen, is my screen visible to everyone?
Shall we go for lunch?

kn: ಒಂದು ಗಂಟೆ ಆಯ್ತು, ಕ್ಯಾಂಟೀನ್‌ಗೆ ಊಟಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋಗೋಣ್ವಾ?
translit: Ondhu gante aaythu, canteen-ge ootakke hogonwaa?
en: It is one o-clock, shall we go to the canteen for lunch?
The printer is not working.

kn: ಪೇಪರ್ ಜಾಮ್ ಆಗಿದೆ ಅನ್ಸುತ್ತೆ, ಪ್ರಿಂಟರ್ ವರ್ಕ್ ಆಗ್ತಿಲ್ಲ.
translit: Paper jam aagidhe ansuththe, printer work aagthilla.
en: I think the paper is jammed, the printer is not working.
What is the Wi-Fi password?

kn: ಗೆಸ್ಟ್ ನೆಟ್‌ವರ್ಕ್ ವೈ-ಫೈ ಪಾಸ್‌ವರ್ಡ್ ಏನು ಅಂತ ಹೇಳ್ತೀರಾ?
translit: Guest network Wi-Fi password enu antha helthira?
en: Can you tell me what the guest network Wi-Fi password is?
Is the meeting room free?

kn: ಹತ್ತು ನಿಮಿಷ ಡಿಸ್ಕಸ್ ಮಾಡ್ಬೇಕು, ಮೀಟಿಂಗ್ ರೂಮ್ ಖಾಲಿ ಇದ್ಯಾ?
translit: Hathu nimisha discuss maadbeku, meeting room khaali idhya?
en: We need to discuss for ten minutes, is the meeting room free?
I will give an update by evening.

kn: ಟೀಮ್ ಜೊತೆ ಮಾತಾಡಿ ಸಂಜೆ ಒಳಗೆ ಅಪ್‌ಡೇಟ್ ಕೊಡ್ತೀನಿ.
translit: Team jothe maathaadi saanje olage update kodthini.
en: I will speak with the team and give an update by evening.
I am leaving now, see you tomorrow.

kn: ಕೆಲಸ ಮುಗೀತು, ನಾನು ಹೊರಡ್ತೀನಿ, ನಾಳೆ ಸಿಗೋಣ.
translit: Kelasa mugeethu, naanu horadthini, naale sigona.
en: Work is finished, I am leaving now, see you tomorrow.
Please give the menu card.

kn: ಸರ್, ಒಂದು ನಿಮಿಷ ಮೆನು ಕಾರ್ಡ್ ಕೊಡಿ.
translit: Sir, ondhu nimisha menu card kodi.
en: Sir, please give the menu card for a minute.
Give one masala dosa.

translit: Crispy aagi ondhu masaale dose kodi.
en: Give one crispy masala dosa.
Please give drinking water.

kn: ಬಿಸಿ ನೀರು ಇದ್ಯಾ? ಕುಡಿಯೋಕೆ ನೀರು ಕೊಡಿ.
translit: Bisi neeru idhya? Kudiyoke neeru kodi.
en: Do you have warm water? Please bring drinking water.
Make it less spicy.
It is for kids, make it less spicy.
Do you have filter coffee?

kn: ಊಟ ಆದಮೇಲೆ ಒಂದು ಸ್ಟ್ರಾಂಗ್ ಫಿಲ್ಟರ್ ಕಾಫಿ ಕೊಡಿ.
translit: Oota aadha mele ondhu strong filter coffee kodi.
en: After food, please give one strong filter coffee.
Please pack it for takeaway.

kn: ಎರಡು ಇಡ್ಲಿ ವಡೆ ಪಾರ್ಸಲ್ ಕಟ್ಟಿ ಕೊಡಿ.
translit: Eradu idli vade parcel katti kodi.
en: Please pack two idli-vada for parcel.
Bring the bill.
Food is done, bring the bill please sir.
Which sweet is available today?

kn: ಬಿಸಿ ಜಾಮೂನ್ ಇದ್ಯಾ? ಇವತ್ತು ಯಾವ ಸ್ವೀಟ್ ಇದೆ?
translit: Bisi jamun idhya? Ivathu yaava sweet idhe?
en: Is hot gulab jamun available? Which sweet do you have today?
Can you serve the order a little quickly?

kn: ಅರ್ಜೆಂಟ್ ಇದೆ, ಆರ್ಡರ್ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಬೇಗ ಕೊಡ್ತೀರಾ?
translit: Urgent idhe, order swalpa bega kodthira?
en: I am in a hurry, could you bring the order quickly?
The food was very good.
The sambar and dosa were very good.
Put less sugar.

kn: ಕಾಫಿಗೆ ಸಕ್ಕರೆ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಕಮ್ಮಿ ಹಾಕಿ ಅಣ್ಣಾ.
translit: Coffee-ge sakkare swalpa kammi haaki anna.
en: Brother, please put a little less sugar in the coffee.
No sugar, please give it without sugar.

kn: ಒಂದು ಟೀ ಸಕ್ಕರೆ ಬೇಡ, ವಿಥೌಟ್ ಶುಗರ್ ಕೊಡಿ.
translit: Ondhu tea sakkare beda, without sugar kodi.
en: Give one tea without sugar, please.

kn: ಇನ್ನು ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಸಾಂಬಾರ್ ಮತ್ತು ಚಟ್ನಿ ಕೊಡಿ.
translit: Innu swalpa sambar mathu chutney kodi.
en: Please give a little more sambar and chutney.

kn: ಸರ್, ಇಡ್ಲಿಗೆ ಇನ್ನು ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಬಿಸಿ ಸಾಂಬಾರ್ ಮತ್ತು ಚಟ್ನಿ ಕೊಡಿ.
translit: Sir, idlige innu swalpa bisi sambar mathu chutney kodi.
en: Sir, please give a little more hot sambar and chutney for the idli.
What is today’s special?

kn: ಮಧ್ಯಾಹ್ನ ಊಟಕ್ಕೆ ಇವತ್ತಿನ ಸ್ಪೆಷಲ್ ಏನು ಇದೆ?
translit: Madhyaahna ootakke ivaththina special enu idhe?
en: What is today’s special for lunch?
This is a pure vegetarian restaurant, right?

kn: ಅಣ್ಣಾ, ಇದು ಪ್ಯೂರ್ ವೆಜ್ ಹೋಟೆಲ್ ಅಲ್ವಾ?
translit: Anna, idhu pure veg hotel alvaa?
en: Brother, this is a pure vegetarian restaurant, right?

kn: ಕೈ ತೊಳೆಯೋಕೆ ವಾಶ್ ಬೇಸಿನ್ ಎಲ್ಲಿ ಇದೆ?
translit: Kai tholeyoke wash basin elli idhe?
en: Where is the wash basin to wash hands?

kn: ಸರ್, ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಕೈ ತೊಳೆಯೋಕೆ ವಾಶ್ ಬೇಸಿನ್ ಎಲ್ಲಿ ಇದೆ?
translit: Sir, illi kai tholeyoke wash basin elli idhe?
en: Sir, where is the wash basin here to wash hands?
Give one shared (by-two) coffee.

kn: ನಾವಿಬ್ಬರು ಇದ್ದೀವಿ, ಒಂದು ಸ್ಟ್ರಾಂಗ್ ಬೈ-ಟು ಕಾಫಿ ಕೊಡಿ.
translit: Naavibbaru iddhivi, ondhu strong by-two coffee kodi.
en: There are two of us, please give one strong by-two coffee.
Make the dosa with less oil.

kn: ಪ್ಲೈನ್ ದೋಸೆಗೆ ಎಣ್ಣೆ ಕಮ್ಮಿ ಹಾಕಿ ಮಾಡಿ ಕೊಡಿ.
translit: Plain dose-ge enne kammi haaki maadi kodi.
en: Please make the plain dosa with less oil.
Do you have curd or buttermilk?

kn: ಊಟದ ಕೊನೆಗೆ ಒಂದು ಗ್ಲಾಸ್ ಮಜ್ಜಿಗೆ ಇದ್ಯಾ?
translit: Ootadha konege ondhu glass majjige idhya?
en: Do you have a glass of buttermilk at the end of the meal?
Please wipe and clean the table.

kn: ತಮ್ಮಾ, ಈ ಟೇಬಲ್ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಕ್ಲೀನ್ ಮಾಡಿ ಕೊಡಿ.
translit: Thamma, ee table swalpa clean maadi kodi.
en: Young brother, please wipe and clean this table.
Where do you want to go, sir?
feedback_or_explanation: Speaker: Auto Driver (Hiring an Auto in Bengaluru)

en: Will you go to Majestic? Please put the meter.
feedback_or_explanation: Perfect! Clear destination and polite meter request.

en: How much for Majestic?
feedback_or_explanation: Acceptable, but asking for flat fare encourages off-meter quotes.

en: Go go, I am in a hurry.

kn: ಮೆಜೆಸ್ಟಿಕ್ ತುಂಬಾ ಟ್ರಾಫಿಕ್ ಇದೆ. ಮೀಟರ್ ಮೇಲೆ ಇಪ್ಪತ್ತು ರೂಪಾಯಿ ಎಕ್ಸ್ಟ್ರಾ ಕೊಡಿ.
translit: Majestic thumba traffic idhe. Meter mele ippathu roopaayi extra kodi.
en: There is heavy traffic towards Majestic. Give 20 rupees extra above the meter.
feedback_or_explanation: Speaker: Auto Driver (Hiring an Auto in Bengaluru)

kn: ಸರಿ ಅಣ್ಣಾ, ಮೀಟರ್ ಹಾಕಿ, ಇಪ್ಪತ್ತು ರೂಪಾಯಿ ಎಕ್ಸ್ಟ್ರಾ ಕೊಡ್ತೀನಿ.
translit: Sari anna, meter haaki, ippathu roopaayi extra kodthini.
en: Okay brother, put the meter, I'll pay 20 rupees extra.
feedback_or_explanation: Very pragmatic and polite agreement in Bengaluru traffic.

en: No, I will only pay the meter charge.
feedback_or_explanation: Fair demand, though driver might decline during peak hours.

en: I won't give extra, you are lying.
feedback_or_explanation: Aggressive phrasing; likely to cause conflict.

en: It will be 150 rupees, come.
feedback_or_explanation: Speaker: Auto Driver (Hiring an Auto in Bengaluru)

kn: ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಕಮ್ಮಿ ಮಾಡಿ ಅಣ್ಣಾ, ನೂರಕ್ಕೆ ಬನ್ನಿ ಅಥವಾ ಮೀಟರ್ ಹಾಕಿ.
translit: Swalpa kammi maadi anna, noorakke banni athava meter haaki.
en: Reduce a little brother, come for 100 or put meter.
feedback_or_explanation: Smart negotiation back to fair rate or meter.

en: Okay, I'll give 150.
feedback_or_explanation: Directly accepted, slightly higher than standard fare.

en: Too high, no.
Majestic has arrived. Where should I stop?
feedback_or_explanation: Speaker: Auto Driver (Hiring an Auto in Bengaluru)

kn: ಮುಂದೆ ಮೆಟ್ರೋ ಸ್ಟೇಷನ್ ಹತ್ರ ಲೆಫ್ಟ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಲ್ಲಿಸಿ.
translit: Munde metro station hathra left-nalli nillisi.
en: Please stop ahead on the left near the metro station.
Stop right here.
feedback_or_explanation: Clear, though doesn't specify safe kerb side.

en: Stop stop!
Meter is 150. Will you pay cash?
feedback_or_explanation: Speaker: Auto Driver (Hiring an Auto in Bengaluru)

kn: ಕ್ಯಾಶ್ ಇಲ್ಲ ಅಣ್ಣಾ, ಸ್ಕ್ಯಾನರ್ ಇದ್ಯಾ? UPI ಮಾಡ್ತೀನಿ.
translit: Cash illa anna, scanner idhya? UPI maadthini.
en: No cash brother, do you have a scanner? I will do UPI.
feedback_or_explanation: Standard practical payment query in Bengaluru.

en: Yes, look here, 150 rupees.

kn: ಚೇಂಜ್ ಇಲ್ಲ, ಎರಡು ಸಾವಿರ ನೋಟ್ ತಗೊಳ್ಳಿ.
translit: Change illa, eradu saavira note thagoli.
en: No change, take a 2000 note.
feedback_or_explanation: Tough for auto drivers to break high-denomination notes.

kn: ಬನ್ನಿ ಸಾರ್, ತಾಜಾ ತರಕಾರಿ ಇದೆ. ಏನು ಬೇಕು?
translit: Banni saar, thaaja tharakaari idhe. Enu beku?
en: Come sir, fresh vegetables are here. What do you need?
feedback_or_explanation: Speaker: Vendor (Buying Vegetables at the Market)

en: How much for onions and tomatoes?
Tell the vegetable rates.
Looks like this isn't fresh.
feedback_or_explanation: Skeptical opening without even checking prices.

kn: ಈರುಳ್ಳಿ ಕಿಲೋಗೆ ನಲವತ್ತು ರೂಪಾಯಿ, ಟೊಮ್ಯಾಟೋ ಮೂವತ್ತು ರೂಪಾಯಿ.
translit: Eerulli kiloge nalavathu roopaayi, tomato moovathu roopaayi.
en: Onions are forty rupees a kilo, tomatoes thirty rupees.
feedback_or_explanation: Speaker: Vendor (Buying Vegetables at the Market)

kn: ಎರಡು ಕಿಲೋ ಈರುಳ್ಳಿ ತಗೊಂಡ್ರೆ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಕಮ್ಮಿ ಮಾಡ್ತೀರಾ?
translit: Eradu kilo eerulli thagondre swalpa kammi maadthira?
en: If I take two kilos of onions, will you reduce the price a bit?

kn: ಒಂದು ಕಿಲೋ ಈರುಳ್ಳಿ, ಅರ್ಧ ಕಿಲೋ ಟೊಮ್ಯಾಟೋ ಕೊಡಿ.
translit: Ondhu kilo eerulli, ardha kilo tomato kodi.
en: Give one kilo onion, half kilo tomato.
It is much cheaper in other shops!

kn: ಸರಿ ಸಾರ್, ಎರಡು ಕಿಲೋ ಈರುಳ್ಳಿ ಎಪ್ಪತ್ತು ರೂಪಾಯಿಗೆ ಕೊಡ್ತೀನಿ. ಕವರ್ ಬೇಕಾ?
translit: Sari saar, eradu kilo eerulli eppathu roopaayige kodthini. Cover bekaa?
en: Okay sir, I'll give 2 kilos onions for seventy rupees. Do you need a bag?
feedback_or_explanation: Speaker: Vendor (Buying Vegetables at the Market)

kn: ಹೌದು, ಒಂದು ಕವರ್ ಕೊಡಿ. ಜೊತೆಗೆ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಕೊತ್ತಂಬರಿ ಸೊಪ್ಪು ಹಾಕಿ.
translit: Haudhu, ondhu cover kodi. Jothege swalpa kothambari soppu haaki.
en: Yes, give a bag please. Also add a little coriander greens.

kn: ನನ್ನ ಹತ್ರ ಬ್ಯಾಗ್ ಇದೆ, ಕವರ್ ಬೇಡ.
translit: Nanna hathra bag idhe, cover beda.
en: I have my own bag, no carry bag needed.
Give bag fast.
Total is seventy rupees sir.
feedback_or_explanation: Speaker: Vendor (Buying Vegetables at the Market)

en: Do you have PhonePe scanner? I will scan.
Here is 100 rupees, please give change.
I only have a 500 note.
Hello, what seems to be the problem?

kn: ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ ಡಾಕ್ಟರ್, ಎರಡು ದಿನದಿಂದ ಜ್ವರ ಮತ್ತು ತಲೆ ನೋವು ಇದೆ.
translit: Namaskaara doctor, eradu dhinadhinda jvara mathu thale novu idhe.
en: Hello doctor, I have fever and headache for two days.
I am not feeling well, give medicine.
I'm very sick, check quickly.
feedback_or_explanation: Impatient and gives no medical details.

kn: ಚಳಿ ಬರ್ತಾ ಇದ್ಯಾ? ಕೆಮ್ಮು ಅಥವಾ ಗಂಟಲು ನೋವು ಇದ್ಯಾ?
translit: Chali barthaa idhya? Kemmu athava gantalu novu idhya?
en: Are you getting chills? Do you have cough or sore throat?

kn: ಹೌದು ಡಾಕ್ಟರ್, ರಾತ್ರಿ ಚಳಿ ಬರುತ್ತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಗಂಟಲು ನೋವು ಇದೆ.
translit: Haudhu doctor, raathri chali baruththe mathu gantalu novu idhe.
en: Yes doctor, chills at night and throat pain is there.
A little cough is there.
Don't know, you check yourself.

kn: ವೈರಲ್ ಫೀವರ್ ಇರಬಹುದು. ಮೂರು ದಿನಕ್ಕೆ ಮಾತ್ರೆ ಬರೆದಿದ್ದೀನಿ.
translit: Viral fever irabahudu. Mooru dhinakke maathre baredhiddhini.
en: Likely viral fever. I have prescribed tablets for three days.

kn: ಈ ಮಾತ್ರೆ ಊಟ ಆದ್ಮೇಲೆ ತಗೋಬೇಕಾ ಡಾಕ್ಟರ್?
translit: Ee maathre oota aadhmele thagobekaa doctor?
en: Should I take these tablets after food doctor?
feedback_or_explanation: Essential question for safe medication intake.

en: How many times a day should I take them?
No injection, only tablets are enough.
feedback_or_explanation: Preemptive assumption before the doctor suggested injection.

kn: ಹೌದು, ಬೆಳಗ್ಗೆ ಮತ್ತು ರಾತ್ರಿ ಊಟ ಆದ್ಮೇಲೆ ತಗೊಳ್ಳಿ. ಬಿಸಿ ನೀರು ಕುಡಿಯಿರಿ.
translit: Haudhu, belagge mathu raathri oota aadhmele thagoli. Bisi neeru kudiyiri.
en: Yes, take morning and night after food. Drink warm water.
Thank you doctor, will do so.
No tests needed?
Okay okay, I am leaving.
feedback_or_explanation: Too casual for a clinical consultation.

translit: Hi, ninne helidha report ready aaythaa?
en: Hi, is the report mentioned yesterday ready?
feedback_or_explanation: Speaker: Colleague (Discussing a Task with a Colleague)

kn: ಹಾಯ್, ಕೆಲಸ ಮುಗಿದಿದೆ. ಈಗಲೇ ಮೇಲ್ ಕಳಿಸ್ತೀನಿ.
translit: Hi, kelasa mugidhidhe. Eegale mail kalisthini.
en: Hi, work is finished. I will send the email right away.
I will send it in half an hour.

translit: Innu shuru maadilla, thumba kelasa ithu.
en: Haven't started yet, had too much work.
feedback_or_explanation: Could communicate delays earlier with better context.

translit: Super! Mooru gantege client meeting idhe, neevu join aagthira?

kn: ಮುಂದೆ ಹೋಗಿ, ಸಿಗ್ನಲ್ ಹತ್ರ ರೈಟ್ ತಗೊಳ್ಳಿ.
translit: Munde hogi, signal hathra right thagolli.
en: Go straight ahead, take a right near the signal.

kn: ಸರ್, ಮುಂದೆ ಹೋಗಿ, ಮೊದಲನೇ ಸಿಗ್ನಲ್ ಹತ್ರ ರೈಟ್ ತಗೊಳ್ಳಿ.
translit: Sir, munde hogi, modhalane signal hathra right thagolli.
en: Sir, go straight and take a right at the first signal.
Take a left and go a little further ahead.

kn: ರೌಂಡಾನಾ ಹತ್ರ ಲೆಫ್ಟ್ ತಗೊಂಡು ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಮುಂದೆ ಹೋಗಿ.
translit: Roundabout hathra left thagondu swalpa munde hogi.
en: Take a left near the circle and go a little forward.
Is there any landmark nearby?

kn: ಅಣ್ಣಾ, ಈ ಏರಿಯಾದಲ್ಲಿ ಯಾವುದೇ ದೊಡ್ಡ ದೇವಸ್ಥಾನ ಅಥವಾ ಲ್ಯಾಂಡ್‌ಮಾರ್ಕ್ ಇದ್ಯಾ?
translit: Anna, ee area-nalli yaavudhe dodda dhevasthaana athava landmark idhya?
en: Brother, is there any big temple or landmark in this area?
Should we go over the flyover or below?

kn: ಡ್ರೈವರ್ ಅಣ್ಣಾ, Silk Board flyover ಮೇಲೆ ಹೋಗ್ಬೇಕಾ, ಕೆಳಗೆ ಹೋಗ್ಬೇಕಾ?
translit: Driver anna, Silk Board flyover mele hogbekaa, kelage hogbekaa?
en: Driver brother, should we take the Silk Board flyover or go below?
Where can we take a U-turn?

kn: ಮುಂದೆ ಡಿವೈಡರ್ ಕಟ್ ಇದ್ಯಾ? ಯು-ಟರ್ನ್ ಎಲ್ಲಿ ತಗೋಬಹುದು?
translit: Munde divider cut idhya? U-turn elli thagobahudhu?
en: Is there a median opening ahead? Where can we take a U-turn?
Does this road lead to the Ring Road?

kn: ಸರ್, ಈ ಗಲ್ಲಿ ದಾರಿ Outer Ring Road-ge ಹೋಗುತ್ತಾ?
translit: Sir, ee galli dhaari Outer Ring Road-ge hoguthaa?
en: Sir, does this lane lead out to Outer Ring Road?

kn: ನನ್ನ ಡೆಸ್ಟಿನೇಷನ್ ಇನ್ನು ಎಷ್ಟು ದೂರ ಇದೆ?
translit: Nanna destination innu eshtu dhoora idhe?
en: How much further is my destination?

kn: ಅಣ್ಣಾ, ಮೆಜೆಸ್ಟಿಕ್ ಇನ್ನು ಎಷ್ಟು ದೂರ ಇದೆ?
translit: Anna, Majestic innu eshtu dhoora idhe?
en: Brother, how much further is Majestic from here?
Can I walk there, or is an auto needed?
Can I walk to the metro station from here?
Go to the opposite side of that road.

kn: ಮೆಡಿಕಲ್ ಶಾಪ್ ಆ ಕಡೆ ಆಪೋಸಿಟ್ ರೋಡ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿದೆ, ರೋಡ್ ಕ್ರಾಸ್ ಮಾಡಿ.
translit: Medical shop aa kade opposite road-nallidhe, road cross maadi.
en: The medical shop is on the opposite road, please cross the road.

kn: ನಾನು ದಾರಿ ತಪ್ಪಿಸಿಕೊಂಡಿದ್ದೀನಿ, ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಹೆಲ್ಪ್ ಮಾಡಿ.
translit: Naanu dhaari thappisikondiddhini, swalpa help maadi.
en: I have lost my way, please help me out.

kn: ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ ಸರ್, ನಾನು ಹೊಸಬ, ದಾರಿ ತಪ್ಪಿಸಿಕೊಂಡಿದ್ದೀನಿ, ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಹೆಲ್ಪ್ ಮಾಡಿ.
translit: Namaskara sir, naanu hosaba, dhaari thappisikondiddhini, swalpa help maadi.
en: Hello sir, I am new here and lost my way, please help me.
How many rupees is this?

kn: ಅಣ್ಣಾ, ಈ ಒಂದು ಕೆಜಿ ಈರುಳ್ಳಿ ಎಷ್ಟು ರೂಪಾಯಿ?
translit: Anna, ee ondhu kg eerulli eshtu roopaayi?
en: Brother, how many rupees for this one kg onion?
Do you have change for five hundred rupees?

kn: ನನ್ನ ಹತ್ರ ಕ್ಯಾಶ್ ಐನೂರು ನೋಟ್ ಇದೆ, ಚಿಲ್ಲರೆ ಇದ್ಯಾ?
translit: Nanna hathra cash ainooru note idhe, chillare idhya?
en: I have a five hundred cash note, do you have change?
What is the time right now?

kn: ಸರ್, ನಿಮ್ಮ ವಾಚ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಈಗ ಸಮಯ ಎಷ್ಟು?
translit: Sir, nimma watch-nalli eega samaya eshtu?
en: Sir, what time is it on your watch?
The appointment is at ten thirty.

kn: ಡಾಕ್ಟರ್ ಹತ್ರ ಹತ್ತೂವರೆ ಗಂಟೆಗೆ ಅಪಾಯಿಂಟ್‌ಮೆಂಟ್ ಇದೆ, ಬೇಗ ಹೋಗ್ಬೇಕು.
translit: Doctor hathra haththoo-vare gantege appointment idhe, bega hogbeku.
en: I have a doctor's appointment at 10:30, I need to leave soon.
I will arrive in fifteen minutes (quarter of an hour).

kn: ಟ್ರಾಫಿಕ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಇದ್ದೀನಿ, ಇನ್ನು ಕಾಲು ಗಂಟೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಆಫೀಸ್‌ಗೆ ಬರ್ತೀನಿ.
translit: Traffic-nalli iddhini, innu kaalu ganteyalli office-ge bartheeni.
en: I am in traffic, I will reach the office in fifteen minutes.
Lunch time is from 1:30 to 2:30.

kn: ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್ ಒಂದೂವರೆಯಿಂದ ಎರಡೂವರೆ ವರೆಗೆ ಲಂಚ್ ಬ್ರೇಕ್ ಇರುತ್ತೆ.
translit: Bank ondhoo-vareyindha eradoo-vare varege lunch break iruththe.
en: The bank lunch break is from 1:30 to 2:30.
How much did the total come to?

kn: ಎಲ್ಲ ತರಕಾರಿ ಸೇರಿಸಿ ಟೋಟಲ್ ಎಷ್ಟು ಆಯ್ತು ಅಣ್ಣಾ?
translit: Ella tharakaari serisi total eshtu aaythu anna?
en: Adding all the vegetables, what is the total amount, brother?
Please give the twenty rupees balance.

kn: ನಾನು ನೂರು ಕೊಟ್ಟೆ, ಇಪ್ಪತ್ತು ರೂಪಾಯಿ ಬ್ಯಾಲೆನ್ಸ್ ಕೊಡಿ ಸರ್.
translit: Naanu nooru kotte, ippaththu roopaayi balance kodi sir.
en: I gave a hundred, please give back twenty rupees balance, sir.

kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ತಿಂಗಳು ಐದನೇ ತಾರೀಖು ಬಾಡಿಗೆ ಕೊಡ್ತೀನಿ.
translit: Prathi thingalu aidhane thaareekhu baadige kodtheeni.
en: I pay rent on the 5th of every month.

kn: ಓನರ್ ಸರ್, ಪ್ರತಿ ತಿಂಗಳು ಐದನೇ ತಾರೀಖು ಆನ್‌ಲೈನ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಬಾಡಿಗೆ ಹಾಕ್ತೀನಿ.
translit: Owner sir, prathi thingalu aidhane thaareekhu online-nalli baadige haaktheeni.
en: Owner sir, I will transfer the rent online on the 5th of each month.
Please wait two minutes, I am coming.

kn: ಡೆಲಿವರಿ ಬಾಯ್ ಬಂದ್ರು, ಎರಡು ನಿಮಿಷ ವೇಟ್ ಮಾಡಿ ಕೆಳಗೆ ಬರ್ತೀನಿ.
translit: Delivery boy bandhru, eradu nimisha wait maadi kelage bartheeni.
en: The delivery partner is here, please wait two minutes, I will come down.
Please leave the parcel with security.

kn: ನಾನು ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಇಲ್ಲ, ಪಾರ್ಸೆಲ್ ಗೇಟ್ ಸೆಕ್ಯುರಿಟಿ ಹತ್ರ ಇಟ್ಟು ಹೋಗಿ.
translit: Naanu maneyalli illa, parcel gate security hathra ittu hogi.
en: I am not at home, please leave the parcel with the gate security.
What time does the waste collection van come tomorrow?

kn: ಅಕ್ಕ, ನಾಳೆ ಬೆಳಿಗ್ಗೆ ಕಸ ಗಾಡಿ ಎಷ್ಟು ಗಂಟೆಗೆ ಬರುತ್ತೆ?
translit: Akka, naale belagge kasa gaadi eshtu gantege baruththe?
en: Sister, what time does the garbage van arrive tomorrow morning?

kn: ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕರೆಂಟ್ ಹೋಗಿದೆ, ನಿಮ್ಮ ಮನೇಲೂ ಹೋಗಿದ್ಯಾ?
translit: Maneyalli current hogidhe, nimma maneloo hogidhya?
en: The power is out in our house, is it out in yours too?

kn: ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ ಸರ್, ನಮ್ಮ ಫ್ಲ್ಯಾಟ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಕರೆಂಟ್ ಹೋಗಿದೆ, ನಿಮ್ಮ ಮನೇಲೂ ಹೋಗಿದ್ಯಾ?
translit: Namaskara sir, namma flat-nalli current hogidhe, nimma maneloo hogidhya?
en: Hello sir, power is out in our flat, is it gone in your home as well?
Water is not coming from the tap.

kn: ಪ್ಲಂಬರ್ ಅಣ್ಣಾ, ಬಾತ್‌ರೂಮ್ ಟ್ಯಾಪ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ನೀರು ಬರ್ತಿಲ್ಲ, ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ನೋಡಿ.
translit: Plumber anna, bathroom tap-nalli neeru barthilla, swalpa nodi.
en: Plumber brother, water isn't running in the bathroom tap, please take a look.
Are you coming to clean the house today?

kn: ಅಕ್ಕ, ಇವತ್ತು ಮನೆ ಕ್ಲೀನ್ ಮಾಡೋಕೆ ಎಷ್ಟು ಗಂಟೆಗೆ ಬರ್ತೀರಾ?
translit: Akka, ivathu mane clean maadoke eshtu gantege barthira?
en: Sister, what time will you be coming to clean the house today?

kn: ನನ್ನ ಪಾರ್ಕಿಂಗ್ ಜಾಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಬೇರೆ ಗಾಡಿ ನಿಲ್ಲಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ.
translit: Nanna parking jaagadhalli bere gaadi nillisidhdhaare.
en: Someone else has parked in my parking spot.

kn: ಸೆಕ್ಯುರಿಟಿ ಸರ್, Flat 204 parking ಜಾಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಬೇರೆ ಗಾಡಿ ನಿಲ್ಲಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ, ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಹೇಳಿ.
translit: Security sir, Flat 204 parking jaagadhalli bere gaadi nillisidhdhaare, swalpa heli.
en: Security sir, another car is parked in Flat 204 spot, please inform them.
Please turn down the volume slightly.

kn: ರಾತ್ರಿ ತುಂಬಾ ಲೇಟ್ ಆಗಿದೆ, ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು ಟಿವಿ ಸೌಂಡ್ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಕಮ್ಮಿ ಮಾಡಿ.
translit: Raathri thumba late aagidhe, dhayavittu TV sound swalpa kammi maadi.
en: It is quite late at night, please turn down the TV volume slightly.

kn: ನಾವು ಊರಿಗೆ ಹೋಗ್ತಾ ಇದ್ದೀವಿ, ಮೂರು ದಿನ ಇರಲ್ಲ.
translit: Naavu oorige hogthaa iddhivi, mooru dhina iralla.
en: We are traveling to our hometown, we won't be here for three days.

kn: ಆಂಟಿ, ನಾವು ಊರಿಗೆ ಹೋಗ್ತಾ ಇದ್ದೀವಿ, ಹಾಲು ಪೇಪರ್ ಹಾಕಬೇಡಿ ಅಂತ ಹೇಳಿದ್ದೀನಿ.
translit: Aunty, naavu oorige hogthaa iddhivi, haalu paper haakbedi antha heliddhini.
en: Aunty, we are heading to our hometown, I have told them not to deliver milk and paper.
The doorbell isn't audible, please call my phone.

kn: ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆಲ್ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡ್ತಿಲ್ಲ, ಬಂದ್ರೆ ಫೋನ್ ಮಾಡಿ.
translit: Maneyalli bell kelasa maadthilla, bandhre phone maadi.
en: The doorbell isn't working at home, please call when you arrive.
What is the Wi-Fi password?

kn: ಬ್ರದರ್, ನಿಮ್ಮ ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ Wi-Fi password ಏನು?
translit: Brother, nimma maneyalli Wi-Fi password enu?
en: Brother, what is the Wi-Fi password in your home?
Hello, how are you?

kn: ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ ಸರ್, ಆರಾಮಾಗಿದ್ದೀರಾ? ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಎಲ್ಲ ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿದ್ದಾರಾ?
translit: Namaskara sir, aaraamaagiddhira? Maneyalli ella chennaagidhdhaaraa?
en: Hello sir, are you doing well? Is everyone fine at home?
I am fine, how about you?
I am doing well brother, how about you?
Had your meal? (Common warm Kannada greeting)
Hello sister, have you had your lunch?
What is your name?

kn: ನನ್ನ ಹೆಸರು ರಾಹುಲ್, ನಿಮ್ಮ ಹೆಸರು ಏನು ಸರ್?
translit: Nanna hesaru Rahul, nimma hesaru enu sir?
en: My name is Rahul, what is your name, sir?
I know a little bit of Kannada.

kn: ನಾನು ಹೊಸಬ, ನನಗೆ ಕನ್ನಡ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಬರುತ್ತೆ, ಕಲೀತಾ ಇದ್ದೀನಿ.
translit: Naanu hosaba, nanage Kannada swalpa swalpa baruththe, kalithaa iddhini.
en: I am new here, I speak a little Kannada, I am still learning.
Please come inside and have a seat.

kn: ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ ಸರ್, ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು ಒಳಗೆ ಬನ್ನಿ, ಸೋಫಾ ಮೇಲೆ ಕೂತ್ಕೊಳ್ಳಿ.
translit: Namaskara sir, dhayavittu olage banni, sofa mele koothkolli.
en: Hello sir, please come inside and take a seat on the sofa.
Would you like some coffee or tea?

kn: ಏನು ತಗೋತೀರಾ? ಬಿಸಿ ಫಿಲ್ಟರ್ ಕಾಫಿ ಅಥವಾ ಟೀ ತಗೋತೀರಾ?
translit: Enu thagothira? Bisi filter coffee athava tea thagothira?
en: What will you have? Would you like hot filter coffee or tea?
Thank you very much for your help.

kn: ಸರಿಯಾದ ಸಮಯಕ್ಕೆ ಹೆಲ್ಪ್ ಮಾಡಿದ್ರಿ, ತುಂಬಾ ಧನ್ಯವಾದಗಳು.
translit: Sariyaadha samayakke help maadidhri, thumba dhanyavaadhagalu.
en: You helped me just in time, thank you very much.
See you again, I'll take leave! (Standard polite parting)

kn: ಆಯ್ತು ಅಣ್ಣಾ, ಕೆಲಸ ಇದೆ, ಮತ್ತೆ ಸಿಗೋಣ, ಬರ್ತೀನಿ!
translit: Aaythu anna, kelasa idhe, mathe sigona, bartheeni!
en: Alright brother, I have some work, see you again, I will take leave!
Pardon me for the inconvenience.

kn: ನನ್ನಿಂದ ತಡ ಆಯ್ತು, ಕ್ಷಮಿಸಿ ಸರ್, ತೊಂದರೆ ಕೊಟ್ಟಿದ್ದಕ್ಕೆ.
translit: Nannindha thada aaythu, kshamisi sir, thondhare kottiddhakke.
en: I got delayed, sorry sir for causing the trouble.
please give
feedback_or_explanation: Purpose: Politely asking someone to hand over, serve, or provide something. | When: Whenever you place an order, buy groceries, or ask for a bill. | Where: restaurant, shop, market, office, clinic

en: Register: polite
feedback_or_explanation: Tip: Attach 'kodi' directly after the item name to make any request courteous. | Common Mistake: Using 'kodu' with elders, strangers, or service staff sounds blunt and rude; always use 'kodi'.

en: Please give one cup of coffee.
Okay sir, two minutes.
want / need
feedback_or_explanation: Purpose: Expressing that you need or desire something. | When: When stating what items, services, or destinations you want. | Where: shop, market, restaurant, auto, home

en: Register: both
feedback_or_explanation: Tip: Pair with 'nanage' (to me): 'Nanage idhu beku' (I need this). | Common Mistake: Do not say 'Naanu beku'; in Kannada, need is expressed passively as 'Nanage beku' (to me it is needed).

en: I need to go to Majestic.
Come sir, I will put the meter.
don't want / no need
feedback_or_explanation: Purpose: Politely refusing an item, extra service, or offer. | When: When declining extra sugar, a carry bag, or unwanted rides. | Where: restaurant, shop, market, auto, home

en: Register: both
feedback_or_explanation: Tip: Say 'Beda, thanks' with a warm smile to refuse politely without sounding harsh. | Common Mistake: Avoid shouting 'beda'; soften it with 'beda, thanks' or 'beda anna'.

en: Do you need a plastic cover sir?
No need, I have a bag with me.
is there / exists / I have
feedback_or_explanation: Purpose: Confirming the existence or presence of something. | When: When stating that an item is available, present, or in your possession. | Where: shop, clinic, office, home, anywhere

en: Register: both
feedback_or_explanation: Tip: Combine with 'nanna hathra' to mean 'with me / I have': 'Nanna hathra change idhe'. | Common Mistake: Remember that 'idhe' is for inanimate objects; for people, use 'idhdhaare' (polite).

en: Do you have a pen with you?
Yes, I have one, please take it.
no / not available
feedback_or_explanation: Purpose: Negating a statement or indicating non-existence. | When: When answering 'no' or informing someone an item is out of stock. | Where: shop, restaurant, auto, office, anywhere

en: Register: both
feedback_or_explanation: Tip: A quick 'illa' followed by the reason keeps communication efficient. | Common Mistake: 'Illa' means 'no / not there', whereas 'beda' means 'don't want'. Don't use 'illa' when someone offers tea and you mean 'no thank you'.

en: Do you have change, brother?
No sir, please pay by UPI.
done / okay / finished
feedback_or_explanation: Purpose: Acknowledging an agreement or confirming that an action has completed. | When: When agreeing to a fare, confirming an order, or stating dinner is done. | Where: auto, restaurant, office, home, anywhere

en: Register: both
feedback_or_explanation: Tip: 'Aaythu' is the universal agreement word in Bengaluru spoken Kannada. | Common Mistake: Avoid using 'aaythu' for greetings; save it for acknowledging that work, eating, or discussion is completed.

en: Give twenty rupees over the meter.
Okay done, please drive quickly.
how much / how many
feedback_or_explanation: Purpose: Asking for quantities, prices, or time. | When: Whenever inquiring about prices or counts. | Where: market, shop, auto, restaurant, anywhere

en: Register: both
feedback_or_explanation: Tip: Say '[item] eshtu?' to instantly ask the price of any product. | Common Mistake: Do not confuse 'eshtu' (how much) with 'elli' (where).

en: How much for one kg of these apples?
One hundred and twenty rupees, sir.
where
feedback_or_explanation: Purpose: Asking for locations, directions, or whereabouts. | When: When searching for a metro station, washroom, or doctor's room. | Where: auto, bus-metro, clinic, office, anywhere

en: Register: both
feedback_or_explanation: Tip: Combine with 'idhe': '[Place] elli idhe?' is the golden direction formula. | Common Mistake: Pronounce as 'elli', not 'yelli' (though spelling with 'y' is colloquial, pronunciation is smooth 'e').

en: Where is the ATM, sir?
It is just ahead on the left side, look.
why
feedback_or_explanation: Purpose: Asking for reasons or causes. | When: When asking why an auto is stopping, or why a delivery is late. | Where: auto, office, home, anywhere

en: Register: both
feedback_or_explanation: Tip: Add 'enu samasye' (what problem) if you want to sound softer than a blunt 'yaake'. | Common Mistake: Saying just 'yaake?!' with sharp intonation sounds accusatory; tone of voice matters.

en: Why did you stop here, brother?
The signal ahead is red, sir.
a little / slightly / please
feedback_or_explanation: Purpose: Softening any request or specifying a small quantity. | When: When asking someone to move aside, lower the volume, or add less spice. | Where: auto, bus-metro, restaurant, shop, anywhere

en: Register: polite
feedback_or_explanation: Tip: Placing 'swalpa' before any verb instantly makes you sound polite and local. | Common Mistake: Never skip 'swalpa' when squeezing past people in buses or metro; it prevents rudeness.

en: Please give a little side space, brother.
Yes, please come ahead.
fast / quickly / early
feedback_or_explanation: Purpose: Urging speed or requesting an early arrival. | When: When catching a train or asking food to be served fast. | Where: auto, restaurant, office, anywhere

en: Register: both
feedback_or_explanation: Tip: Say 'swalpa bega' (a little quickly) to sound polite rather than demanding. | Common Mistake: Barking 'bega bega!' repeatedly can offend drivers; use 'swalpa bega' once respectfully.

kn: ಟ್ರೈನ್ ಮಿಸ್ ಆಗುತ್ತೆ, ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಬೇಗ ಹೋಗಿ.
translit: Train miss aaguththe, swalpa bega hogi.
en: I will miss the train, please drive a bit faster.
Okay sir, I will go through the shortcut.
look / please see
feedback_or_explanation: Purpose: Directing someone's attention or asking them to check something. | When: When asking someone to check an app payment or inspect a spot. | Where: shop, clinic, office, anywhere

en: Register: polite
feedback_or_explanation: Tip: 'Swalpa nodi' is polite for 'please check this'. | Common Mistake: Use 'nodi' (polite plural/honorific), not 'nodu' (casual/singular).

en: I have completed payment on the phone, please check.
Yes sir, received, thanks.
please come
feedback_or_explanation: Purpose: Politely inviting or calling someone over. | When: Welcoming visitors, asking an auto to come to your gate, or inviting someone in. | Where: home, office, shop, auto, anywhere

en: Register: polite
feedback_or_explanation: Tip: Combine with 'olage' (inside): 'Olage banni' (please come inside). | Common Mistake: 'Baa' is only for young children or very close peers; always use 'banni' with adults.

en: Hello sir, please come in.
Thank you, how are you doing?
please go
feedback_or_explanation: Purpose: Instructing someone to move or go in a direction. | When: When directing an auto driver or telling someone where to proceed. | Where: auto, bus-metro, anywhere

en: Register: polite
feedback_or_explanation: Tip: Use with 'munde' (forward): 'Munde hogi' (Go straight). | Common Mistake: Never tell an elder or service person 'hogu'; always say 'hogi'.

en: Cross the signal and go straight ahead.
Okay sir, I will make a U-turn ahead.
please tell / say
feedback_or_explanation: Purpose: Inviting someone to speak or asking for information. | When: When answering the phone, attending a counter, or asking for clarification. | Where: shop, office, clinic, anywhere

en: Register: polite
feedback_or_explanation: Tip: Greeting someone with 'Namaskara, heli sir' is the standard polite greeting at counters. | Common Mistake: Don't use 'helu' with elders; 'heli' is the respectful imperative.

en: Tell me sir, which medicine do you need?
Please give one strip of paracetamol.
ask / listen
feedback_or_explanation: Purpose: Asking someone to inquire or listen. | When: When telling someone to ask security or check with a colleague. | Where: office, auto, shop, anywhere

en: Register: polite
feedback_or_explanation: Tip: 'Swalpa keli' is a polite way to get someone's attention on the street. | Common Mistake: 'Keli' means both 'ask' and 'listen' depending on context ('keli' = listen, 'keli nodi' = ask and see).

kn: ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಕೇಳಿ, ಈ ಬಸ್ ಕಡೆ ಹೋಗುತ್ತಾ?
translit: Swalpa keli, ee bus kade hoguthaa?
en: Excuse me, does this bus go in that direction?
Please ask the conductor, he will tell you.
will happen / it is possible / it costs
feedback_or_explanation: Purpose: Expressing that an event will occur, cost a certain amount, or be feasible. | When: When discussing fare amounts, completion times, or feasibility. | Where: auto, shop, office, anywhere

en: Register: both
feedback_or_explanation: Tip: 'Eshtu aaguththe?' is the standard phrase for 'How much will it come to?'. | Common Mistake: Negating 'aaguththe' is 'aagalla' (it won't happen / not possible).

kn: ಈ ಶರ್ಟ್ ಹೊಲಿಯೋಕೆ ಎಷ್ಟು ದಿನ ಆಗುತ್ತೆ?
translit: Ee shirt holiyoke eshtu dhina aaguththe?
en: How many days will it take to stitch this shirt?
It will take three days, sir.
available / can be found
feedback_or_explanation: Purpose: Confirming that an item or service is available to obtain. | When: When asking if tickets, items, or medicines can be found here. | Where: shop, market, clinic, bus-metro

en: Register: both
feedback_or_explanation: Tip: Turn into question by lengthening ending: 'Illi milk packet siguthaa?' | Common Mistake: Use 'siguththe' for availability to buy/find; use 'idhe' for existing in place.

en: Is tender coconut available nearby?
It is available at the corner ahead, see.
comes / I know (a skill/language)
feedback_or_explanation: Purpose: Indicating arrival, or stating that you know a language. | When: When asking about bus arrivals or stating your Kannada language skill. | Where: bus-metro, office, anywhere

en: Register: both
feedback_or_explanation: Tip: 'Nanage Kannada swalpa baruththe' is the most respected sentence a newcomer can say. | Common Mistake: Do not say 'Naanu Kannada gottu'; say 'Nanage Kannada baruththe' or 'Nanage Kannada gottu'.

en: Do you know Kannada?

kn: ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಬರುತ್ತೆ ಸರ್, ಕಲೀತಾ ಇದ್ದೀನಿ.
translit: Swalpa swalpa baruththe sir, kalithaa iddhini.
en: I know a little bit sir, I am learning.
know / aware
feedback_or_explanation: Purpose: Expressing knowledge of a fact, route, or person. | When: When confirming you know a place, or stating 'Gothilla' (I don't know). | Where: auto, office, home, anywhere

en: Register: both
feedback_or_explanation: Tip: Negative is 'gothilla' (I don't know): 'Nanage aa address gothilla'. | Common Mistake: Never say 'Naanu gothu'; always use dative 'Nanage gottu' (to me it is known).

en: Do you know the route to this temple, brother?
I know it sir, please sit, I will take you there.
is good / nice
feedback_or_explanation: Purpose: Complimenting food, an item, or answering that you are well. | When: When giving feedback on a meal, checking clothes, or responding to greetings. | Where: restaurant, shop, office, home, anywhere

en: Register: polite
feedback_or_explanation: Tip: Say 'Coffee thumba chennaagidhe' to brighten any server's day. | Common Mistake: To ask about a person's health, use 'Chennaagiddhira?' (Are you well?), not 'Chennaagidheya?' (which is for objects).

en: How is the dosa, sir?
It is very good, the chutney is great!
very / much / lot
feedback_or_explanation: Purpose: Intensifying an adjective or expressing gratitude strongly. | When: When expressing high degree (very spicy, very hot, thank you very much). | Where: anywhere

en: Register: both
feedback_or_explanation: Tip: Combine with 'dhanyavaadha': 'Thumba dhanyavaadha' (Thank you very much). | Common Mistake: Spell as 'thumba', never 'thumpa'. In Kannada script it is always ತುಂಬಾ.

en: Is the sambar very spicy?
No sir, it is mild.
please stop
feedback_or_explanation: Purpose: Asking a driver to stop the vehicle. | When: When you have arrived at your stop or destination. | Where: auto, bus-metro, anywhere

en: Register: polite
feedback_or_explanation: Tip: Say 'Illi nillisi' (Stop here) or 'Munde nillisi' (Stop ahead). | Common Mistake: Never shout 'nillu' to a driver; 'nillisi' is the respectful request.

en: Please stop near that gate, brother.
Okay sir, I will pull to the left.
near / close to / with (a person)
feedback_or_explanation: Purpose: Indicating proximity to a landmark or possession by someone. | When: When describing where to drop you, or asking who has something. | Where: auto, shop, anywhere

en: Register: both
feedback_or_explanation: Tip: 'Metro hathra' = near the metro; 'Nanna hathra' = with me. | Common Mistake: Don't confuse 'hathra' (near) with 'dhoora' (far).

en: Where should I drop you, sir?
Please drop me near metro pillar 120.
far / distance
feedback_or_explanation: Purpose: Asking about or indicating distance. | When: When checking whether a destination is walkable. | Where: auto, bus-metro, anywhere

en: Register: both
feedback_or_explanation: Tip: 'Thumba dhoora' = very far; 'Eshtu dhoora?' = how far? | Common Mistake: Remember the dental 'dh' sound in 'dhoora', not the English 'd' in door.

en: Is the railway station very far?
No, just about one kilometer.
today
feedback_or_explanation: Purpose: Referring to the present day. | When: When talking about today's specials, today's leave, or today's plans. | Where: office, restaurant, home, anywhere

en: Register: both
feedback_or_explanation: Tip: Combine with 'special': 'Ivathu special enu?' (What's special today?). | Common Mistake: Don't confuse 'ivathu' (today) with 'naale' (tomorrow) or 'nenne' (yesterday).

en: What is the special for lunch today?
There is bisibelebath and kesaribath, sir.
tomorrow
feedback_or_explanation: Purpose: Referring to the next day. | When: When scheduling follow-up visits, leaves, or maid appointments. | Where: office, clinic, home, anywhere

en: Register: both
feedback_or_explanation: Tip: 'Naale banni' = please come tomorrow; 'Naale sigona' = see you tomorrow. | Common Mistake: In Kannada 'naale' means tomorrow. (Unlike Hindi 'kal' which means both yesterday and tomorrow, Kannada has separate words: 'nenne' for yesterday, 'naale' for tomorrow).

en: Will the doctor be available tomorrow?

kn: ಹೌದು ಸರ್, ಬೆಳಿಗ್ಗೆ ಹತ್ತು ಗಂಟೆಗೆ ಬನ್ನಿ.
translit: Haudu sir, belagge haththu gantege banni.
en: Yes sir, please come at ten in the morning.
okay / correct / fine
feedback_or_explanation: Purpose: Agreeing, confirming accuracy, or saying alright. | When: When confirming a deal, agreeing to a timing, or saying all is correct. | Where: anywhere

en: Register: both
feedback_or_explanation: Tip: 'Sari aaythu' = alright, agreed; 'Idhu sari idhe' = this is correct. | Common Mistake: Remember that 'sari' can mean both 'okay' (acknowledgment) and 'correct' (factual truth).

en: I will deliver at three o'clock.
Okay, please call before coming.
yes / that is so
feedback_or_explanation: Purpose: Affirming a question or agreeing formally. | When: When answering yes to a question of identity, fact, or intention. | Where: office, clinic, anywhere

en: Register: both
feedback_or_explanation: Tip: A warm 'Haudu' is polite and universally understood. | Common Mistake: Casual spoken response often shortens to 'haa', but 'haudu' is clear and polite.

en: Have you newly moved to Bengaluru?
Yes, it has been two weeks.
thank you
feedback_or_explanation: Purpose: Expressing gratitude politely. | When: When someone helps with directions, serves your food, or finishes a service. | Where: anywhere

en: Register: polite
feedback_or_explanation: Tip: Say 'Thumba dhanyavaadha anna/sir' to build instant warmth. | Common Mistake: In informal street talk, people also say 'Thanks anna'. Use 'dhanyavaadha' when you want to sound sincere and respectful.

kn: ಇಲ್ಲೇ ಮುಂದೆ ಸಿಂಡಿಕೇಟ್ ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್ ಇದೆ ನೋಡಿ.
translit: Ille munde Syndicate Bank idhe nodi.
en: Just ahead here is the Syndicate Bank, see.
Thank you very much sir!
